components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 保存和发送等单一主要操作。
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: oklch(99% 0.004 255); background: oklch(57% 0.17 255); font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI Variable', sans-serif; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: oklch(51% 0.17 255); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(57% 0.17 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: oklch(24% 0.02 255); background: oklch(95.5% 0.009 255); font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: oklch(92% 0.012 255); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(57% 0.17 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(89% 0.012 255); border-radius: 6px; color: oklch(24% 0.02 255); background: oklch(99% 0.004 255); font: 400 13px 'Segoe UI Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(57% 0.17 255); outline: 3px solid oklch(94% 0.04 255); }

components.name: Side Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav-active { height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: oklch(49% 0.17 255); background: oklch(94% 0.04 255); font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(57% 0.17 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selection Toolbar Button
components.description: 划词工具栏中的紧凑图标按钮。
components.html: <button class='ds-toolbar-button' aria-label='翻译'><svg width='17' height='17' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2'><path d='m5 8 6 6'></path><path d='m4 14 6-6 2-3'></path><path d='M2 5h12'></path><path d='M7 2h1'></path><path d='m22 22-5-10-5 10'></path><path d='M14 18h6'></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-toolbar-button { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: oklch(49% 0.018 255); background: transparent; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-toolbar-button:hover { color: oklch(51% 0.17 255); background: oklch(94% 0.04 255); } .ds-toolbar-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(57% 0.17 255); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: 划词助手服务于已经进行中的阅读和写作任务。界面出现时清楚，使用时直接，完成后退回背景。层级来自排版、留白与色调，边框和阴影只在必要时出现。

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: 强调蓝只表达可操作、已选择或正在进行的状态。

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: 结果回答的字号和行高始终高于周围元信息。

rules.name: The Flat by Default Rule
rules.body: 不离开文档流的区域不得通过阴影表达重要性。

dos: 使用排版、留白和色调建立层级
为完整交互状态提供一致反馈
验证不同主题和 Windows 缩放
donts: 使用渐变、霓虹、玻璃拟态或大面积高饱和颜色
使用大量卡片、边框和阴影
重新发明标准 Windows 控件
